purpose: Teach: 西海岸/ルパン/カンヌ/トロント/スリランカ/レバノン/マニラ/江戸川

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアメリカ西海岸の写真を見せて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad's going to show us photos from the West Coast of America.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact, sharing good news with her son. Gentle rhythm. Setting up a moment she knows will please him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとルパン三世観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched Lupin the Third with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, eager burst. Quick energy on the opening. Bouncing slightly forward in his seat. Genuine pride in sharing what he did. Small voice, big excitement.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがカンヌ映画祭のお話して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad told us such a lovely story about the Cannes Film Festival.
lines.style: Warm, reflective tone. Slight pause before "lovely story" — savoring it. Soft, unhurried pace. Voice like she's remembering the moment as she speaks.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとトロントの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I looked at a picture book about Toronto with Dad!
lines.style: Bright and immediate, same energy as before. Quick leap from listening to sharing. Eager to match her pace. Small laugh underneath.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがスリランカ出張のお土産買って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad brought back such nice souvenirs from his business trip to Sri Lanka.
lines.style: Warm and appreciative. Slight emphasis on "nice" — she's noticing the thoughtfulness. Calm, unhurried delivery. Soft gratitude in the tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとレバノン料理食べたよ
lines.en: Mom, I ate Lebanese food with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, triumphant. Quick-paced. Same eager energy, building slightly with each new thing to report. Voice clear and proud.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがマニラの絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad's going to read us a picture book about Manila.
lines.style: Warm and encouraging. Soft, patient rhythm. Gentle setup for something nice. Building anticipation without pressure.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと江戸川区の花火大会行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad took me to the fireworks festival in Edogawa ward!
lines.style: Bright, proud, and slightly breathless. Peak excitement. Fast delivery. Emphasis on the adventure of it. Genuine joy spilling over.
